title: When to Intervene? An Empirical Study of Errors and Self-Recovery in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.36471v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents interact with Web services to perform tasks on users' behalf. Errors during these interactions can disrupt execution and prevent task completion, motivating external intervention. However, agents may self-recover through continued execution, raising the question of when to intervene and when to wait for self-recovery. We present an empirical study of errors and self-recovery in LLM agents. We construct ReInBench, a dataset containing 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events across computer-use and Web tasks. Our study examines how often and how quickly agents self-recover, how self-recovery relates to subsequent execution and task completion, and whether self-recovery can be predicted when an error occurs. translated_title: 何时干预？LLM智能体中错误与自我恢复的实证研究
translated_abstract: LLM智能体与Web服务交互以代表用户执行任务。这些交互过程中出现的错误可能中断执行并阻碍任务完成，从而促使外部干预。然而，智能体也可能通过持续执行实现自我恢复，这就引出了何时干预、何时等待自我恢复的问题。我们对LLM智能体中的错误与自我恢复进行了实证研究。我们构建了ReInBench，一个包含1,259条智能体轨迹和1,403个错误事件的数据集，涵盖计算机使用和Web任务。我们的研究考察了智能体自我恢复的频率和速度、自我恢复与后续执行及任务完成之间的关系，以及错误发生时能否预测自我恢复。我们发现725个错误事件实现了自我恢复，且通常在几步之内完成，不同执行LLM的自我恢复表现存在差异。自我恢复还能帮助智能体从后续同类错误中恢复并成功完成……
tldr: 该论文构建了ReInBench数据集（含1,259条智能体轨迹和1,403个错误事件），首次系统实证研究LLM智能体的错误自我恢复现象，发现大量错误可在几步内自我恢复，为判断何时干预、何时等待提供了依据。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ReInBench, an empirical study of 1,259 agent traces and 1,403 error events showing that many LLM agent errors self-recover within a few steps, providing guidance on when to intervene versus wait for self-recovery.
